role: Static app FAQ/feature reference injected into the assistant's system prompt (full or compact, AIProvider+SystemPrompt.swift:140) and served section-by-section by the app.help.lookup fact tool (AppFactResolver+HealthKitFacts.swift:137).
types: AppKnowledgeBase: enum — holds reference/referenceCompact prompt text, help topic list and the lookup/extractSection functions
state: mem:AppKnowledgeBase.helpTopics (static let [String], 14 topics incl. 'all'; read by referenceCompact and the app.help.lookup tool description)
toplevel: reference and referenceCompact are multi-line string literals of product claims (tabs, recovery-score weights 60/25/15 with all three factors, 70/30 without vitals or 85/15 on a night with HRV more than 1 SD below baseline and a sleep score under 50, HRV only without sleep, SpO2 -10 penalty below 95%, Comeback 80/20/0 for 21 days, HR zones, exports, navigation paths, capabilities). referenceCompact's lookup example is 'what's TRIMP' (covered by the Metrics section) and its valid-topic list is interpolated from helpTopics, which the tool description in AppFactResolver+HealthKitFacts.swift interpolates too.

units.does: Returns the app-reference section for a topic string: normalizes (trim surrounding whitespace/newlines first, then lowercase, '-' and ' ' → '_'), returns the full reference for 'all', the matching '## heading' section for a known alias, and referenceCompact for unknown topics or a missing heading. Called by the app.help.lookup fact (AppFactResolver+HealthKitFacts.swift).

branches.effect: fallback referenceCompact when the heading text is not found in reference

units.does: Scans reference line by line, starting capture at the first line beginning with '## '+heading and stopping at the next '## ' line; returns the captured block trimmed, or nil if the heading never appears.

branches.cond: already inside the section AND line starts with '## '
line starts with target heading (prefix match)

branches.effect: return nil; else return joined trimmed section
